tables.title: Hunter rules
rows: Raise one of each damage upgrade at a time. A balanced path beats maxing one line, and class or gear barely change the order. On 2026-09-09 the author wrote that its math predates the Hourglass and 4-star cards: the Hourglass gives lots of crit and no ATK%, so crit lines (Dice, Damage Abuse, Wish for Luck, Pray for Luck) lose value against ATK% lines. Power Training stays the best Hunter upgrade, Fire Elementals next.

Each level costs 1.7 times the one before: level 10 is 202 materials, 15 is 2,860, 20 is 40,600, 25 is 577K and 30 is 8.19M. Two trainings differ: Hunter Cost Reduction costs 1.5 times the last (1,300 x 1.5^L gold) and Speed Training (movement) 1.55 times (900 x 1.55^L gold).

Every training: 30 (base) + up to 15 from Engineer More Hunting (5 each in Blueprint, Runic Blueprint and Sun Scroll) + 4–12 from the Act 1 Hard card (0–4 stars) = 57 max. Speed Training (attack) stays at 30.

Two separate modifiers: Hunter Cost Reduction (the training, the Crab Miner and Helmet cards, the ash node) adds into one divisor, and the Cost Cruncher removes a percentage of what is left (up to 99%).
Engineer Hunter Tax Returns adds 5% per level ("Hunter Upgrade Refund 5%" in the wiki data), 10 levels across Idea and Blueprint.
The Engineer guide says a refund returns half the level's materials, about a quarter off on average at 50%. The wiki data does not give the size, so this is unverified until checked in game.
Farm crab miners until the card drops: a permanent Hunter discount. Card and ash discounts add into one cost divisor (450% in total divides costs by 5.5).
Hunter Cost Cruncher (gem shop, 5 levels, 300–500 gems)

Builds up a discount each day, up to 99%. The guides give 2% a day per level (10% a day at level 5), but the wiki data shows only "10% → 99%", so the daily rate is unverified until checked in game. The next Hunter upgrade consumes it, so spend it on one expensive upgrade such as Hunter Cost Reduction.
Plants for Power, Fire Elementals for More Damage, Slime Cubes for Dice, Weird Books for Damage Abuse, Pebbles for Defence if you are dying. Boars (HP) are the lowest priority.

Woodcutting Power, Mining Power, Woodcutting Experience and Mining Experience use Act 2 and Act 3 materials (Ironwood Log, Thorium Ore, Palm Tree Log, Beetleman Sting), so the "every combat and Act 1 training" tiers leave them out: level them as their materials open.

tables.title: Hunter trainings
rows: Strength Training: +1 STR (+10% attack for Warriors, additive)
Dexterity Training: +1 DEX (+10% attack for Rogues, additive)
Intelligence Training: +1 INT (+10% attack for Mages, additive)
More Damage Training: ATK multiplier, x0.01 per level (multiplies everything else)
Endurance Training: +1 CON (+5% max HP, +1% HP regen)
Meditation Training: +1 MEN (+5% max mana, +1% mana regen, +5% magic defence)
